tasks: Do the 100 h tasks (grease, bolts, spindles).

Check gearbox for leaks at the two crank-side oil seals and input seal; check oil condition. At ~10-30 h/yr these units will not reach 500 h for many years - change oil every 3 years or if milky/dirty (best practice, not in manual).

Check draw rods, rubber stops and element alignment.
Inspect PTO shaft, guard and slip-clutch linings.
Count tine stock (16 x 18 mm or 24 x 12 mm per set) and lock bolts.
m_items.source: Best practice built on OEM 100 h list

knives.name: EdgeMax Microcut Short, top 3 deg (more aggressive)

m_hoc.guidance: Greens at 2.4-2.7 mm: Microcut family (115-1880 std or 93-4262). Daily: check light contact, adjust 1 click = 0.018 mm. After grind/new knife: 0.05 mm shim at each end, then 3 clicks closer, paper test. Backlap via InfoCenter SERVICE > BACKLAP as needed; file burr off front edge after. Grind when land > 3 mm: 30 deg relief to 0.8 mm land, spin to < 0.025 mm run-out; scrap reel at 114.3 mm or > 0.25 mm taper. Bedknife front angle 13-17 deg; check grinder with angle indicator 131-6828 + mount 131-6829. Keep contact light and edges sharp - it directly extends battery run time (OM). Groomer no deeper than half the HOC.

knives.name: JRM extended-cut tournament 13-hole (aftermarket, OEM ref ET17534)

m_hoc.guidance: Unit is 22 in. QA5, 5 in. reel, 7/11/14 blade, HOC range 2.0–22 mm. At the current 4 mm use UC18869 tournament, ET11066 or JRM 4BD250103; UC28163 also cuts at 4 mm but is a thin greens knife. Do not use UC23562 or UC28156 at 4 mm. Front roller bracket: with a 2 in. front roller and no GTC/FTC/brush, position 3 gives 1–9.5 mm (position 2 is 0–4 mm, too close to the limit); with GTC/FTC/brush use position 3 (0–11 mm). Bedknife-to-reel clearance 0.025–0.050 mm; adjust one flat at a time, alternating sides, finishing by pulling the knife away from the reel. Backlap: all three units together, operator off seat, park brake on, reel speed low enough that compound isn't thrown, coarse then fine compound, wash off with water while still reversing, then re-set clearance. Grind: bedknife ground with its support, 6.5° top relief; front relief 15° on low-cut knives, 5° on high-cut. Spin grind then relief grind the reel, then backlap to remove burrs. New knife: 13 new screws at 7 N·m from the centre out, set front roller parallel, set clearance, set HOC, backlap, recheck HOC.

Grease the 5 fittings per unit at 50 h and after washing. Grind: 30 deg relief to 1.3 mm land when land > 3 mm; end-to-end diameter difference < 0.25 mm. Bedknife screws 29.8 +/-1 N.m; bedbar bolts 37-45 N.m. Replace the knife at its service limit (lip height above bottom: 4.8 mm, Tournament 3.4 mm). Note: 3456-847 Rev D lists newer knife numbers (147-12xx); the cutting-unit catalog 3451-988 still shows older ones (110-4084, 120-1640, 108-9096, 110-4074) - order by the newer manual numbers and let the dealer supersede.

Bedknife screws 119-4151: 195 on hand
Lapping paste on hand: Mowermate 120 grit (medium) x1, Mowermate 220 grit (fine) x1

knives.name: JRM high-cut 11-hole 18.25 in. (OEM ref TCU25299 → UC18867 → UC28157)

m_hoc.guidance: 5 x 18 in. QA5 units (Notion's 'QA7 22 in.' is wrong). At 4 mm fit UC18877 (or UC28164/TCU36878). The JRM 4BD250222 in template 33626 is a high-cut knife rated 4.4 mm minimum — it is below its rating at 4 mm. Bedknife-to-reel 0.025–0.050 mm, adjust one flat at a time alternating sides. Backlap with ~0.076 mm at the ends, through TechControl (enable backlap in service menu). Grind: 6.5° top / 5° front relief on the knife, relief-grind reels after spin grinding, backlap afterwards. Reels are electric — no hydraulic reel motors, no reel-circuit pressures to test.
stock: Bedknives on hand for 4 mm: none; UC18877 18 in. tournament suits
Lapping paste on hand: Mowermate 120 grit (medium) x1, Mowermate 220 grit (fine) x1

m_models.model: Greens Keeper 75 L pedestrian turf sprayer
m_models.engine: 12 V battery-powered Shurflo diaphragm pump, 13.6 L/min, 45 psi (per BA spec). 12 V battery and charger supplied.
daily_checks: Battery charged (charge after every use with the supplied charger).
Tank lid strainer in place when filling; tank lid vent clear.
Suction filter clean (easy-access bowl) - clean after every tank.
Run clean water through and check every nozzle pattern; individual nozzle shut-offs work; no drips at non-drip bodies.
Pressure regulator/gauge reading steady; speedo working.
Tyres (pneumatic, smooth) inflated evenly so the boom sits level.
After spraying: triple-rinse tank, flush pump/lines/nozzles with clean water, drain via drain tap; clean outside; wash nozzles and filters.

intervals.label: Monthly in use
tasks: Calibrate output: catch-test each nozzle for 1 min at working pressure; replace nozzles more than ~10% above new flow (best practice).
Inspect hoses and clamps (stainless only); check boom straight and level.
Check battery terminals and harness/fuses.
intervals.source: Best practice (no BA manual obtained)

intervals.label: Annual / end of season
tasks: Replace nozzle set if worn (TeeJet air-induction, 250 mm spacing - match existing tips).
Replace non-drip diaphragms and suction-filter screen if hard/torn.
Check pump output/pressure-switch cut-out; fit Shurflo valve/diaphragm kit if pump struggles (kit to match pump model on label).
Wheel bearings check/grease; frame and boom hinges.
Winter storage: flush, run a pump-safe antifreeze/storage solution if freezing risk, battery on maintenance charge.
intervals.source: Best practice (no BA manual obtained)

reel.guidance: Boom 1.5 m (GK75) or 2 m (GK-75-2M) - confirm which is fitted to serial D27058.

known_issues: Pump damage if run dry; dirty suction filter starves pump.
Chemical residue left in lines blocks nozzles and perishes diaphragms - flush after every use.
m_models.notes: No BA operator manual was obtainable online (their manuals portal loads by script). Ask BA (03 5278 9033) for the GK75 manual/parts list for serial D27058.

m_models.model: Universal AERA-vator UA60 (60 in, 3-point, PTO) with SB60 seedbox
m_models.engine: None - tractor PTO 540 rpm, 1-3/8 in spline driveline (AE55-082). 1:1 right-angle centre gearbox (AE54-018), 4 x BX46 belts to the tine shaft. Tine vibration 800 cycles/min at 540 PTO rpm.
daily_checks: Machine level: check gearbox oil at the right-hand side plug - oil should just flow out; top up via top plug. Do not overfill.
All gearbox plugs in; all guards, belt covers and PTO shields fitted and chained.
Grease driveline: U-joints every 8 h, inner (telescoping) tube every 16 h, guard plastic bearings every 40 h.
Grease 3-point hitch horizontal and vertical swing pivots - weekly (decal 'GREASE WEEKLY').
Tines tight and not worn short; no missing tines or lockwashers.
Seedbox (if used): chain idler has no slack after first 50 ft of seeding; chain transmission oiled as needed; seed cups clean and dry.
After use: clean off dirt and seed; store dry.

intervals.label: First hour of use - belts
tasks: Check belt tension: ~18 lb push midway between pulleys = about 3/8 in deflection. Tighten via idler locknut if slack - don't over-tension.
intervals.source: Operator's manual (SN 3309+) p.15 Belt Tension

intervals.label: Every 8 h - driveline U-joints
tasks: Grease both PTO U-joints (multipurpose grease).
intervals.source: Manual p.20 Lubrication (AE55-082 driveline)

intervals.label: Every 16 h - driveline inner tube
tasks: Grease telescoping inner tube of the PTO shaft.
intervals.source: Manual p.20

intervals.label: Every 40 h - belts and guard bearings
tasks: Check belt tension (3/8 in deflection at ~18 lb).
Grease PTO guard plastic bearings.
intervals.source: Manual p.15 and p.20

intervals.label: Weekly in use
tasks: Grease 3-point hitch horizontal and vertical pivots.
Oil the chain coupler (access from top of jackshaft cover) as required.
Anti-seize on turnbuckle threads as required.

fluids.spec: Multipurpose grease; multipurpose oil; anti-seizing agent

intervals.source: Manual p.20-22

intervals.label: End of season / annual
tasks: Clean off all dirt and grease.
Check tines/shells/blades for wear; replace worn tines (torque tine nuts 210 ft-lb / 285 Nm with the supplied socket AE60T003).
Check belts for wear/cracks; replace as a set of 4 (AE50-093 BX46).
Lubricate everything per the lubrication pages.
Check gearbox for leaks; gearbox service is a dealer job per 1st Products (no change interval given). Best practice: change SAE 90 gear oil every 2-3 seasons or if contaminated.
Rotor hub, roller and jackshaft bearings are sealed - check for play/noise only. Rotor shaft nut torque 350 ft-lb on reassembly.
intervals.source: Manual p.16-22 (storage, tines, rotor service); oil-change frequency = best practice

fluids.spec: SAE 90W gear lube - fill to side check plug

reel.guidance: Tines: replace worn tines across the shaft for even depth (vibrating depth 3-3/4 in). Torque 210 ft-lb. Rotor service: rotor nut 350 ft-lb, turn rotors as it tightens; if a rotor locks the bearing adapters are not phased 180 deg.

known_issues: Gearbox damage if run low on oil or overfilled - check level with machine level.
Over-tensioned belts fail early and overload bearings.
Rotor bearing cones forced apart = internal seals ruined (keep cones together when removing).
Seedbox idler slack after the first 50 ft of seeding - re-tighten.
m_models.notes: No telematics. Two manual editions by serial: SN 3245-3308 and SN 3309+ - check the UA60 serial plate. Specs: 60 in working width, 510 lb (less shaft), 9 holes/sq ft, side-to-side tine travel 1-3/8 in; seeder hopper 6.7 cu ft, 15 outlets.

Ball-picker baskets/picking units free of debris and damage; unload full baskets.
Tyres/wheels and deck: no wrapped debris; blades (if mowing) sharp and tight.
Battery charge level; charger and leads dry and undamaged.

m_models.model: 2550 PrecisionCut Triplex Mower (diesel, hydraulic reel drive)
m_models.engine: Yanmar 3TNV74F-NDJGM, 3-cyl indirect-injection diesel, 993 cc, liquid cooled (OM spec). 14.6 kW / 19.6 hp SAE J1995 (dealer spec sheet). 20 A alternator, 12 V battery 500 CCA. Not a Yanmar 3TNV76 and no 48 V alternator (that is the 2550 E-Cut Hybrid).
daily_checks: Engine oil level (dipstick between marks).
Hydraulic oil level (main reservoir; aux reservoir HOT/COLD marks).
Coolant level.
Look for oil/fuel/coolant leaks.
Tyres: smooth 2-ply 10–12 psi (69–83 kPa); 4-ply smooth/balloon 15 psi (103 kPa).
Test safety interlocks: seat switch, mow-transport lever switch, raise-lower lever switch.
Brakes and park brake hold.
Air restriction indicator and rubber dust unloading valve.
Loose, missing or damaged parts; all guards and shields fitted.
Fuel/water separator (sediment bowl): orange ring floats on water — drain/clean if water present.
Pedals and steering; seat belt.
Reel-to-bedknife: light, even contact across full length (paper test); backlap/adjust as needed (OEM says inspect, backlap, adjust and check daily for a uniform cut).
After use: refuel, clean debris off machine, radiator/oil cooler and cutting units; grease cutting units straight after washing.

intervals.label: Break-in (first 50 h)
tasks: Change hydraulic oil and filter (done long ago on this unit — listed for completeness)
Check all hoses and clamps
Clean mow valve screen
Check wheel hardware
intervals.source: Operator's Manual omuc24434 (2400/2550 PrecisionCut & 2550 E-Cut Hybrid, Export Edition) — Service Intervals

intervals.label: 50 h service (grease)
tasks: Grease front lift-arm pivots and centre lift-arm pivot (units lowered to ground)
Grease rear wheel steering spindle; grease rear wheel bearings
Each cutting unit: yoke pivot, reel bearings (both ends), front roller (both ends), rear roller (both ends), rear-roller HOC adjusters
Rear roller power brush / turf conditioner supports, if fitted
Clean battery terminals; check battery fluid if not sealed
Don't over-grease — excess drops onto the turf

fluids.spec: JD Special Purpose HD Water Resistant or JD Multi-Purpose HD Lithium Complex
JD Special Purpose Golf & Turf Cutting Unit Grease or JD Multi-Purpose SD Polyurea

intervals.source: Operator's Manual omuc24434 (2400/2550 PrecisionCut & 2550 E-Cut Hybrid, Export Edition) — Service Intervals; 'Lubricating Greens Mower' and 'Lubricating Cutting Units'

intervals.label: 100 h
tasks: Check spark arrestor (if fitted)
NOTE: the 100 h oil change in the OEM table is for the petrol 2400 only — not the 2550

reel.guidance: Unit is 22 in. QA5, 5 in. reel, 7/11/14 blade, HOC range 2.0–22 mm. At the current 4 mm use UC18869 tournament, ET11066 or JRM 4BD250103; UC28163 also cuts at 4 mm but is a thin greens knife. Do not use UC23562 or UC28156 at 4 mm. Front roller bracket: with a 2 in. front roller and no GTC/FTC/brush, position 3 gives 1–9.5 mm (position 2 is 0–4 mm, too close to the limit); with GTC/FTC/brush use position 3 (0–11 mm). Bedknife-to-reel clearance 0.025–0.050 mm; adjust one flat at a time, alternating sides, finishing by pulling the knife away from the reel. Backlap: all three units together, operator off seat, park brake on, reel speed low enough that compound isn't thrown, coarse then fine compound, wash off with water while still reversing, then re-set clearance. Grind: bedknife ground with its support, 6.5° top relief; front relief 15° on low-cut knives, 5° on high-cut. Spin grind then relief grind the reel, then backlap to remove burrs. New knife: 13 new screws at 7 N·m from the centre out, set front roller parallel, set clearance, set HOC, backlap, recheck HOC.

known_issues: No JD service bulletins for the 2550 were found in the sources read.
Hydraulic oil filter has a status indicator above the filter — change the filter early if the plunger sits in the red zone.
OEM troubleshooting has a 'Hydraulic Reel Motor Diagnostics (2400/2550 PrecisionCut)' chart — use it for slow/stalling reels before replacing motors.
Machine is now cutting 4 mm on tees/surrounds — make sure the bedknives fitted are rated for 4 mm (not the 7.6 mm high-cut knife) and the front roller bracket is in the right range.
m_models.notes: PIN 1TC2550HVNT030138 is a normal JD 17-character PIN (1TC = JD Turf; 10th character 'N' = 2022), consistent with the record. Use the Export Edition OM (omuc24434) — Australian machines follow it. Most OEM intervals are 'hours OR yearly' — set calendar triggers. At ~1,888 h the next OEM service is the 500 h/yearly service at 2,000 h (plus check whether the 1,500 h injector check and the 1,500 h hydraulic oil change were done). Telematics (JDLink) support for this unit not researched.

known_issues: Tractor 2 'Error 65': OM error table = 'Err 65 Right Amber Lamp OFF — output from the display is open; no right hazard signal on the ROPS; check the right amber lamp'. So it is the rear-right amber hazard/turn lamp circuit — blown bulb or open wiring/connector to that lamp — not a brake-light fault.
Err 08 (logged on a 3520 in the workshop notes): OM = 'Throttle Sensor — voltage out of range or not calibrated; no anti-stall, loss of performance' — dealer calibration/wiring check.

Other OM codes: Err 60–67 = ROPS turn/hazard lamps (60/61 right red, 62/63 left red, 64/65 right amber, 66/67 left amber; ON = short, OFF = open); Err 02/03 pedal signal; Err 15 operator not in seat; Err 57 HST controller timeout.
Do not use engine oil or type F ATF in the transmission (OM).
m_models.notes: Tractor 1 PIN LV3520H358251 is the old 13-character format with serial 358251 — the 3520 range in the 2008 manual starts at 358001, and a 2012 3520 seen for sale carries a 17-character PIN (1LV3520HKCH840519). So Tractor 1 is most likely a 2008–09 build, not 2013 (the register may hold purchase year) — check the PIN plate. Tractor 2's recorded 'serial' LVA13144 is a JD part number ('SCV Port E to Rear Coupler I Oil Line', fits 3520) — the real PIN needs reading off the plate; until then it can't be confirmed which manual/serial-break parts apply. Transmission type (eHydro vs PowrReverser) and cab vs ROPS not recorded — affects oil volume and cab filter. OM used is the North American edition (nearest found); no export-edition 3520 manual was located. At ~3,070 h (T1) the 600 h items were due at 3,000 h; the next 200/400 h service is at 3,200 h for both tractors; T2's 600 h items fall due at 3,000 h.

Cutting at 4 mm with a 4.4–4.8 mm-rated fairway knife will scalp/drag; fit tournament knives.
If it is the Tier 4 engine, DPF regeneration must be allowed to complete (OM has active/parked/recovery regen procedures) — inhibiting regen repeatedly leads to recovery regens.
No service bulletins found in sources read.

known_issues: Club history: spray-volume fault on this ProGator 2030A/AgLeader set-up; Brandt hydraulic testing cleared the JD system and pointed to the AgLeader flow control (escalated to Position Partners). Rate control depends on the flow meter calibration, speed input and the proportional (rate) valve TCA26145 — check those three together.
Diaphragm pump: positive displacement — relief valve must be set (start at 13.8 bar/200 psi); dead-heading without relief damages hoses/pump.
Diaphragms are a hard 12-month/400 h item — a failed diaphragm puts spray mix into the pump oil (best-practice note: milky oil in the sight glass = replace diaphragms now).
No JD service bulletins found in sources read.
m_models.notes: In Australia the HD200 SelectSpray is sold on a ProGator 2030A diesel (RDO listing); the JD page says the sprayer is removable and uses the ProGator speed sensor. The recorded PIN 1TC200GXHNT130078 looks like the sprayer's own PIN (model field '200G…', 10th character N = 2022); record the ProGator 2030A chassis PIN separately — engine/transaxle parts are ordered against the chassis. At ~1,070 h the next OEM points are 1,200 h (oil) and 1,500 h (500 h service + injectors/valve clearance). Use the Export Edition OM omuc24452. Pump oil spec and the HD200 sprayer's own operator's manual were not found — ask Brandt for the HD200 OM.

m_models.model: Verti-Drain 7215 (tractor 3-point, PTO-driven deep-tine aerator)
m_models.engine: None - driven by tractor PTO, 500 rpm max (Redexim advises 400 rpm). Cat 1 three-point linkage. Min tractor ~25 hp with 700 kg lift. Benzi T-40 PTO shaft with friction slip clutch (no shear bolt).
daily_checks: Before each use: walk round - all tines same length/size, none bent; replace a bent tine straight away (machine goes unstable).
Tine lock bolts tight - 40 Nm max (M10). If a tine still slips, grind a small flat on the shank.
PTO guard undamaged and chained; tube overlap at least 250 mm; joint angles under 30 deg and both joints in line.
Crankshaft big-end nuts not loose; no rumble/knock from crank bearings when turned by hand.
Tine angle set for the tine (90 deg for hollow/needle tines; 75-90 deg kick for solids). Depth set evenly both sides (never more than 4 turns one side before evening up).
Rear roller unlocked for solid tines; may be lifted/locked for hollow coring.
Rollers turn freely, scraper in place, no loose bolts/nuts. Look and listen during a 5 min run-up.
After use: clean off soil. For long storage do not leave the tine holders folded up against the stops (shortens shock-absorber spring life).

intervals.label: First 20 h (new or after repair)
tasks: Grease PTO shaft and front/rear rollers - 4 shots each, EP2.
Check all bolts and nuts (re-torque, Loctite any that keep loosening).
Look closely over the whole machine (draw rods, crank, tine holders).
intervals.source: User manual 2434 sec 13.0 Maintenance p.17

intervals.label: Every 40 h - PTO lock bolt
tasks: Check torque of the PTO slip-clutch lock bolt at the gearbox: 80 Nm.
intervals.source: User manual 2434 sec 4.1 p.10

intervals.label: Monthly in season - slip clutch
tasks: Maintain the PTO slip clutch: check it slips/grips correctly, clean inside, replace lining plates if worn or if it slips often. Slip clutch always on the machine side.
intervals.source: Parts manual 2440 PTO T-40 Benzi page P1-3 ('MAINTAIN slipclutch every month')

intervals.label: Every 100 h
tasks: Grease PTO shaft and front/rear rollers - 4 shots each, EP2.
Grease the front roller depth spindles.
Clean depth-adjust spindles/nuts and spray with anti-stick grease oil.
Check all bolts and nuts; look closely at the machine (draw rods, crank bearings, tine holders, element alignment).
intervals.source: User manual 2434 sec 13.0 p.17 and sec 5.0 p.12

intervals.label: Every 500 h - gearbox oil
tasks: Drain and refill gearbox oil: 80W90, 3 L.
intervals.source: User manual 2434 sec 1.0 spec + sec 13.0 p.17

intervals.label: Annual pre-season (calendar fallback - low-hour machine)
tasks: Do the 100 h tasks (grease, bolts, spindles).

Check gearbox for leaks at the two crank-side oil seals and input seal; check oil condition. At ~10-30 h/yr these units will not reach 500 h for many years - change oil every 3 years or if milky/dirty (best practice, not in manual).
Turn crankshaft by hand: feel for tight spots or rumble (crank bearings 6013-LLU, big-end bearings 6006-LLU).
Check draw rods, rubber stops and element alignment.
Inspect PTO shaft, guard and slip-clutch linings.
Count tine stock (16 x 18 mm or 24 x 12 mm per set) and lock bolts.
intervals.source: Best practice built on OEM 100 h list

fluids.source: User manual 2434 sec 1.0 Technical specifications p.7

fluids.spec: Fill space between seal and bearing with NLGI 2-3 bearing grease on assembly; Loctite 5970 on splines

reel.guidance: Tines: tine holders take 3 x 12 mm and 2 x 18 mm holes. Max solid 18 x 250, max hollow 25 x 250; never fit longer/thicker than Redexim lists for the 7215. Depth decal reads true only with 250 mm tines - deduct the difference for shorter/worn tines. Solids: sharp point to front roller (to rear on weak turf); angle 75-90 deg. Hollows: angle 90 deg, side outlet to rear; break hard ground with solids first. Run 400 rpm PTO. Keep matched lengths in a set; worn-short tines can be used for shallower work.

known_issues: Crankshaft big-end nuts working loose = vibration problem or collapsed crank bearing; fix vibration first (machine not level, PTO joints not in line/unequal angles). Replace crank/bearing promptly (manual 14.2.2).
After any crank repair the shaft can run tight - tap cranks to relieve tension (14.2.3) and realign elements (14.3); pre-tension shortens bearing life.
Tines bending/breaking: ground too hard/dry - irrigate first, use shorter/thinner tines, solids before hollows.
Draw rods bending: machine not at 90 deg, worn bearing bushes, or reversing with tines near the ground.
Tine holders 'float' with heavy tines at high rpm and hit the rear roller - drop PTO revs (400 rpm).
Spec conflict to note: tech spec says slip clutch max 400 Nm; Benzi PTO page gives 450 Nm at 28 mm spring length 'for information only - use a test rig'. Have the clutch set on a rig by the dealer.
Club workshop note (Jul 2025): keep spare PTO-cover chains for the Verti-Drains.
m_models.notes: No telematics. Manual found is the current 2022 issue (parts manual shows serial-prefix A.... vs H.... gearwheel differences) - the 2018 unit should be checked against its plate; core service items are the same. VERTI-DRAIN 7007 (Small Verti-Drain 1, 2013, disabled): self-propelled walk-behind, 13 hp electric-start engine (Honda - see Honda parts manual on Redexim site), 675 mm width, 150 mm depth. Maintenance if returned to service: first 20 h grease roller bearing (4 shots EP2), check bolts, renew engine oil; every 100 h grease roller and front roller spindles, renew engine oil, grease rear-wheel chain drive, check bolts; every 500 h renew hydraulic oil (7 L, 10W40). Gearbox is lifetime-greased (EP 00). Max tine 12x150 solid / 19x150 hollow; standard 8x150 solids with adapters. Source: 7007 manual 0948 sec 1.0 and 10.0.

m_models.model: Jr. Sod Cutter 18 in, Honda engine
m_models.engine: Honda GX160 (163 cc, 5.5 hp, recoil start, Oil Alert). Gear-case drive, A-section V-belt engine to gear case, roller chain to drive shaft and blade.
daily_checks: Operator presence system: engine running at 1/2 throttle, master clutch engaged - release presence lever, engine must stop. Do not use if it doesn't.
Blades (bottom and side): no cracks/breaks; do not weld or straighten; sharpen or replace when dull.
Tighten loose nuts/bolts; replace missing cotter pins.
Engine oil level (0.58 L GX160) and fuel.
Grease pitman arms and side arms every 4 h of use (4 fittings) - i.e. at start and halfway through a full day.
Gear case oil level on dipstick (sit dipstick on threads, don't screw in).

intervals.label: Every 4 h of use
tasks: Grease pitman arms (1 each side) and side arms (1 each side) - lithium-based grease.
intervals.source: Ops/Parts manual MAN 4166212 p.15 Lubrication

intervals.label: Every 8 h of use
tasks: Grease side-arm pivots (1 each side, top of unit).

intervals.label: Engine first oil change - first month or 20 h
tasks: Change engine oil.
intervals.source: Honda GX manual maintenance schedule p.7; capacity GX160 0.58 L p.9

intervals.label: Every 3 months or 50 h
tasks: Clean air cleaner elements (more often in dust).
intervals.source: Honda GX manual schedule

intervals.label: Every 6 months or 100 h
tasks: Change engine oil (0.58 L 10W-30).
Clean sediment cup.
Check/adjust spark plug (gap 0.7-0.8 mm).
Clean spark arrester (if fitted).
Check V-belt tension: roll-pin to sleeve gap on master clutch rod 25-30 mm (1 to 1-1/4 in) with clutch engaged; adjust by sliding engine on its 4 mount bolts.
Check brake band: no drag when clutch engaged; stops large pulley when lever pulled firmly back.
intervals.source: Honda GX manual schedule; MAN 4166212 p.11 belt/brake adjustment

intervals.label: Every year or 300 h
tasks: Replace air cleaner paper element.
Replace spark plug (NGK BPR6ES).
Dealer: idle speed (1,400 +200/-150 rpm) and valve clearance (cold, GX120/GX160: IN 0.08 +/-0.02, EX 0.10 +/-0.02 mm).
Clean fuel tank and filter (Honda: every 6 months/100 h - dealer item).
Sod cutter: inspect blades, side-arm and pitman bearings, drive chain and sprockets, gear case for leaks; check gear-case oil (EP140, 1.7 L total - only top up if lost).
intervals.source: Honda GX manual schedule + spec table; MAN 4166212 p.15-18

intervals.label: Every 2 years
tasks: Check fuel tube; replace if cracked (Honda dealer item).
intervals.source: Honda GX manual schedule

fluids.source: Honda GX manual p.9 / Bobcat spec

reel.guidance: Blade sharpening (MAN 4166212 p.16): hand-file bottom blade at 45 deg until no flat remains; keep the cutting edge under 1.5 mm (1/16 in) by grinding the milled surface back at 15 deg; same for side blades; no burrs. Never weld or straighten a blade. Blade pitch 0-9 deg via hand lever - use the flattest angle that holds depth; extreme angles stress the drive.

known_issues: Engine stalls when engaging master clutch = brake band set too tight.
Belt slips/wears if oily or under-tensioned - keep belt clean and set 25-30 mm roll-pin gap.
Dull blades make the cutter ride out of the ground - sharpen before increasing pitch.
m_models.notes: No telematics. Manual found is the 2010 issue covering 544954C; the 2022 unit (serial ...10123) may have detail changes (e.g. rear tyre now 9 x 3.50-4 per Bobcat). Ryan is now a Bobcat brand; parts at shop.bobcat.com / shop.ryanturf.com - AU dealer not confirmed in this research. Workshop note (2025): a trailer was to be built for the sod cutter.

m_models.model: Greensmaster eTriFlex 3370 (all-electric lithium riding greens mower)
m_models.engine: No engine, no hydraulics. 04591: 5 Toro HyperCell lithium-ion batteries, 60 VDC max / 55.2 VDC nominal, 199.85 Ah (about 11 kWh). 04590: 8 lithium-ion batteries, 48 V, 213.6 Ah. Electric wheel motors with oil-filled gearboxes, electric reel motors, electric lift actuators. 12 V circuits run off a DC/DC converter - there is NO 12 V battery on the 3370 (only the petrol-hybrid 3360, model 04580, has one). The 3360 is the petrol hybrid (Kawasaki FS481V 603 cc); the 3370 is lithium-only.
daily_checks: Disconnect the main-power connectors (left of roll bar) before touching reels or cutting units.
Check reel-to-bedknife contact on all 3 units: light contact full length, paper cuts cleanly. Adjust 1 click (0.018 mm) at a time.
Check height of cut (greens 2.4-2.7 mm).
Check tyre pressure - all 3 tyres the SAME, 83-110 kPa (12-16 psi).
Check safety interlocks (seat, reels, park brake), brake operation and InfoCenter (no fault codes).
Inspect seat belt (if fitted).
After mowing: clean up and wash with LOW-pressure water only - no pressure washer (bearings, seals, electrics).
Charge after the day's mowing, within 0-45 C. Keep charger cords clean, coiled and undamaged.
When refitting a cutting unit: coat the reel-motor spline with clean grease.

intervals.label: Break-in 1 h (2026 build only)
tasks: Torque front wheel HUB nuts to 420-461 N.m (310-340 ft-lb). Applies to 04591 s/n 420000000+ (Mower 2) - not in the earlier manuals.

intervals.label: Break-in 8 h
tasks: Torque wheel nuts to 108-122 N.m (80-90 ft-lb), star pattern.

Change traction-motor gearbox oil, LEFT and RIGHT: machine level on stands, remove wheels, drain plug on bottom of gearbox, clean magnetic plug, refill through fill port ~384 ml each with SAE 80W-90, refit vent hose.

intervals.label: Break-in 10 h (2026 build only)
tasks: Torque front wheel HUB nuts to 420-461 N.m (04591 s/n 420000000+ only).

intervals.label: 50 hr service
tasks: Check battery cable connections - tight, clean, no heat marks. Main-power connectors disconnected first.

intervals.label: 200 hr service
tasks: Torque wheel nuts 108-122 N.m (star pattern).
2026 build (Mower 2): also torque front wheel hub nuts 420-461 N.m.

intervals.label: 800 hr service
tasks: Change traction-motor gearbox oil both sides (~384 ml each, SAE 80W-90). Machine must be level.
Clean magnetic drain plugs; look for metal flakes (wheel-motor gearbox wear).

parts.name: Gearbox drain plug (magnetic) - only if damaged

intervals.label: Universal groomer gearbox (only if groomers fitted)
tasks: Change groomer gearbox oil: first at 100 h, then every 500 h or yearly, ~50 ml 80W-90 per gearbox.
intervals.source: Service Manual 19239SL p.2-3 (50 cc 80W-90); interval from Toro bulletin GR 17-02 for universal groomer 04648 (bulletin lists other Greensmaster models, not 04590/04591)

intervals.label: Backlap + adjust reels (as needed)
tasks: OEM gives no hour interval - backlap when the daily contact check shows dull edges. Club practice 10 h / weekly is fine.
InfoCenter: SERVICE > BACKLAP = ON, set BACKLAP RPM in SETTINGS, joystick forward to run. Long-handled brush only.
If reels stall, raise backlap speed. When done set BACKLAP OFF.
Wash compound off with low-pressure water; file burr off bedknife front edge; reset light contact.
Re-check contact after cutting 2 greens following a grind/backlap.
intervals.source: OM 3481-521 p.54 'Backlapping the Cutting Units'; CU OM 3478-832 p.15

intervals.label: Grind reels / replace bedknives (condition-based; club 75 h)
tasks: OEM sets no hours. Grind when backlapping no longer restores edges or land width > 3 mm.
Relief grind 30 deg +/-5 to land 0.8 mm; spin grind to < 0.025 mm run-out. Reel service limit 114.3 mm dia (new 128.5 mm); max taper 0.25 mm.

New bedknife: clean/oil bedbar, NEW screws with anti-seize, outer 2 screws to 1 N.m first, then centre-out to 25.9 +/-1.4 N.m (no impact gun). Grind after fitting: top angle per knife (3 deg Microcut), front 13-17 deg.
Bedbar bolts 27-36 N.m; locknuts until outer steel washers just turn; spring nut collapsed then back 1/2 turn.
Reel and roller bearings are SEALED - nothing to grease. Check for play/roughness; replace bearings 140-5510 or roller kit 140-5552 as needed.
Set bedknife to reel with 0.05 mm shim then 3 clicks; paper test; reset HOC.

parts.name: Bedknife screw (13 per knife, always new)

intervals.label: Storage (more than a few weeks)
tasks: Clean, sharpen if needed, coat reels/bedknives with rust preventive; raise machine off its tyres.
Leave batteries at 40-60 % (54.3-57.3 V on a multimeter, machine off); 50 % ideal - do not store at 100 %.
Store -20 to 25 C for up to 52 weeks (25-45 C: 3 weeks max; 45-55 C: 1 week). Check charge every 6 months.
Disconnect charger from mains and separate the main-power connectors.
intervals.source: OM 3481-521 p.55 'Battery Storage Requirements'

fluids.spec: SAE 80W-90 gear oil (Mobilube HD Plus 80W-90 or equivalent)
04591: 5 x HyperCell Li-ion (145-5385), 55.2 V nominal, 199.85 Ah. 04590: 8 x Li-ion (battery assy 04070), 48 V, 213.6 Ah. Sealed, not user serviceable - opening voids warranty. Charge 0-45 C.
Clean grease on reel-motor spline at cutting-unit refit only (no grease nipples on traction unit or cutting units). Toro Synthetic Grease 136-8595 is the grease used inside the reel motor.
83-110 kPa (12-16 psi), identical on all wheels. Std tyre 19 x 10.50-8 4-ply smooth.

bedknives.name: EdgeMax Microcut Short, top 3 deg (more aggressive)

reel.guidance: Greens at 2.4-2.7 mm: Microcut family (115-1880 std or 93-4262). Daily: check light contact, adjust 1 click = 0.018 mm. After grind/new knife: 0.05 mm shim at each end, then 3 clicks closer, paper test. Backlap via InfoCenter SERVICE > BACKLAP as needed; file burr off front edge after. Grind when land > 3 mm: 30 deg relief to 0.8 mm land, spin to < 0.025 mm run-out; scrap reel at 114.3 mm or > 0.25 mm taper. Bedknife front angle 13-17 deg; check grinder with angle indicator 131-6828 + mount 131-6829. Keep contact light and edges sharp - it directly extends battery run time (OM). Groomer no deeper than half the HOC.

known_issues: Toro bulletin GR 16-15: 48 VDC fuses are specialty items - keep fuse kit 139-8482 on hand. 12 V and 48 V fuses look alike but are not interchangeable.
Batteries overheat in hot sun: InfoCenter high-temperature alert disengages the reels and slows the machine. Park in shade and let it cool (OM 3481-521 p.39).

Range drops with blunt reels, heavy contact, heavy rear-roller brush contact and deep grooming. OEM rating: 13,006 m2 per full charge in the first 4 years (sharp reels, light contact, groomer at half HOC or higher, about 8 miles of transport).
Never pressure wash - bearing seals and electrics.
Never raise the suspension to transport while reel motors sit in the frame holders (motor/wire damage).
Mower 1 model ambiguity: its serial falls in both the 04590 and 04591 ranges. Battery count, charger and catalog depend on the plate.
m_models.notes: Lithium-only confirmed: 3370 = all-electric; 3360 (model 04580) = petrol hybrid with Kawasaki FS481V. The club template line 'lithium battery model - no engine service' is correct, but there is still OEM PM: gearbox oil, torque checks, battery cables. Battery/charger care: charge after each day's use; storage at 40-60 % (OM). The service manual says 50-100 % for 1-6 months - follow the operator's manual for the serial. Telematics: PC 3471-256 (s/n 418200000+, Mower 2) lists Telematics Gateway 161-9001 (addendum 3475-443); the dealer activates it, presumably on Toro's myTurf/Intelli360 platform - confirm with the dealer. Mower 1's catalog (413000000+) lists no gateway. Labour hours are estimates.

m_models.model: Greensmaster Flex 2120 walk-behind greens mower (petrol) - with notes on Greensmaster eFlex 1021
m_models.engine: Subaru 126 cc OHC single-cylinder air-cooled petrol with gear reduction (Toro engine assy 133-8843). Multi-disc wet reel clutch in ATF; poly-V belt drives with spring idlers. Subaru replacement engines are discontinued - Toro replacement kit 139-5637 fits a Honda engine (bulletin GR 04-10).
daily_checks: Engine oil level: engine level and cool, dipstick NOT screwed in, between H and L.
Fuel level (unleaded, max E10). Never tip the machine more than 25 deg (oil into cylinder / fuel out of cap).
Air filter condition; clean engine cooling fins; listen for odd engine or drive noises.
Traction and brake interlock switches; parking-brake operation.
Pivot joints move freely.
Reel-to-bedknife contact (light, paper cuts) and height of cut (#2 set at 5 mm).
Clean with mild detergent and low water - no pressure washer, keep water off the shift plate and engine.

intervals.label: Break-in 20 h
tasks: Change engine oil (warm engine, tip back max 25 deg to drain, drain plug 20-23 N.m).
Clean fuel-tank screen (remove cap, lift out screen, wash in clean fuel).

fluids.spec: API SE or higher; SAE 30 above ~10 C, 10W-30 general use, 5W-30 cold

intervals.label: 50 hr service
tasks: Change engine oil (more often if dusty).
Clean air cleaner: wash foam in soapy water, dry, re-oil and squeeze out; tap paper element (no compressed air).

fluids.spec: API SE+; SAE 30 / 10W-30 per temperature (Toro Premium 10W-30 121-6393 pail)

intervals.label: 100 hr service (fuel screen also monthly)
tasks: Replace paper air-filter element (element set 121-0618).
Check spark plug: NGK BR6HS, gap 0.6-0.7 mm, 23 N.m; replace if cracked/fouled - don't sandblast or wire-brush.
Clean fuel-tank screen (every 100 h or monthly, whichever first).

intervals.label: 500 hr service
tasks: Replace reel-clutch oil with Mobil ATF D/M (Toro 505-136), 296 ml.

fluids.spec: Mobil ATF D/M (Toro 505-136; Toro Premium ATF 108-1186 pail)

intervals.label: 1000 hr service
tasks: Replace fuel line.
Replace engine breather hose.
Inspect reel-drive belt (99-2022, under the belt cover on the cutting unit) and the spring/bearing housing tension.
Check transmission drive belts (main 115-6743, drum 115-6744).
Check transmission bearings.
Check reel clutch: teeth fully disengage and don't bottom out; reel must stop in under 7 s with the bedknife backed off.

intervals.label: Universal groomer gearbox (only if fitted)
tasks: Change groomer gearbox oil: first at 100 h, then every 500 h or yearly, 50 ml 80W-90.
intervals.source: Bulletin GR 17-02 (lists 04044); SM 12188SL (50 ml)

intervals.label: Backlap + adjust (as needed)
tasks: Check contact daily; backlap when dull; file the burr off the bedknife front edge afterwards.

intervals.label: Grind reel / bedknife (condition-based; club 75 h)
tasks: Grind when land > 3 mm: 30 deg relief +/-5, land 0.8-1.2 mm; reel service limit 114.3 mm (new 128.5 mm); max taper 0.25 mm.
New bedknife: new screws, outer 2 to 1 N.m, then 25.4 N.m centre-out; bedbar bolts 27-36 N.m; grind knife after fitting.
Reel and roller bearings are sealed - check, don't grease.
At 5 mm HOC fit a Tournament knife - the standard Microcut tops out at 4.7 mm.

intervals.label: Storage (> 30 days)
tasks: Clean engine fins and blower housing.
Add fuel stabiliser, run 5 min, then drain or run dry; choke-start until it won't start; disconnect plug lead. Don't keep stabilised fuel > 90 days.
Tighten fasteners, touch up paint, store under cover.

fluids.spec: API SE or higher. SAE 30 (warm), 10W-30 (general), 5W-30 (cold) per OM chart
Unleaded 87 (R+M)/2 (= 91 RON in AU), up to E10

reel.guidance: Bench HOC range 1.6-12.7 mm (High HOC kit 7-25 mm). #2 cuts greens at 2.4 mm (Oct 2026): Microcut family (1.5-4.7 mm); above 4.7 mm fit a Tournament knife. Six clip settings via the reel-drive pulley under the cutting-unit belt cover - start matching clip to HOC. Daily contact check, 1 click = 0.018 mm. Grind: 30 deg relief, land 0.8-1.2 mm, relief when > 3 mm; reel limit 114.3 mm; taper 0.25 mm. Bedknife screws 25.4 N.m after outer pair at 1 N.m.

known_issues: Bulletin GR 04-10: Subaru engines for Flex 2100/2120 (MY2011-2019) are no longer available - replacement is Honda engine kit 139-5637. Budget for this when an engine fails across the six units.
Bulletin GR 04-11 is listed for this serial range but the PDF would not download from toro.com - ask the dealer what it covers.

Machinery job MCH-12 (Walk Behind 2 grinding when reels engage, closed 9 Oct): OEM checks for the reel clutch are full disengagement, no bottoming, reel stop < 7 s; clutch parts 132-5484 / 133-8898 / 137-2425.
Do not tip beyond 25 deg (e.g. on the TransPro 80 trailer - use its stops).
Bulletin GR 14-50: universal groomer knob O-ring can perish in sun (groomer drives 04648 s/n 318000001-319999999) - knob kit 137-0959.
m_models.notes: Greensmaster eFlex 1021 (04861, s/n 412826166): battery walk mower, 48 V lithium-ion 25.6 Ah, IP65 (OM 3445-357). OEM PM: tighten handle-isolation hardware after first 20 h; clean after each use; change transmission fluid every 750 h or yearly - 473 ml Dexron VI synthetic, drain plug 4-5 N.m, breather 12-15 N.m; parking brake should release at 16-18 kg on the lever. Battery storage: 40-60 % (50.7-52.1 V), check every 6 months. No engine service. Notion's '04861 onboard charger' entry on the 3370 manifest is this mower's model number. No telematics on the Flex 2120. Labour hours are estimates.

m_models.model: Greensmaster 3150-Q 2-wheel-drive riding greens mower (petrol)
m_models.engine: Briggs & Stratton Vanguard V-twin OHV air-cooled petrol, model 356447, 570 cc (Service Manual 12191SL); Toro engine part 130-6472. Hydrostatic traction, hydraulic reel drive and lift.
daily_checks: Engine oil level (dipstick, engine cold, level ground).
Hydraulic fluid level (sight window or dipstick, fluid cold); check hoses and lines for leaks/kinks.
Test the hydraulic leak-detector alarm (ignition ON, hold leak-detector switch rearward - alarm after 1 s).
Fuel level; air pre-cleaner condition; clean engine cooling fins; listen for unusual engine noise.
Tyre pressure: front 55-83 kPa (8-12 psi), rear 55-103 kPa (8-15 psi).
Reel-to-bedknife contact (light, paper cuts) and height of cut (4-5 mm).
Safety interlocks, brakes, seat belt.
After cleaning: few drops SAE 30 oil or WD-40 on mow, lift and brake pivots. Grease all fittings immediately after every wash.

intervals.label: Break-in 1 h
tasks: Torque wheel nuts 95-122 N.m (70-90 ft-lb), X pattern.

intervals.label: Break-in 10 h
tasks: Torque wheel nuts 95-122 N.m.

tasks: Change engine oil and filter.

intervals.label: Break-in 50 h
tasks: Check battery hold-down fasteners are tight.
Change hydraulic filter (pre-fill new filter with fluid, oil the seal, hand tight +3/4 turn).
Check engine speed: low idle 1650 +/-100, high idle 2850 +/-50 rpm (SM).

intervals.label: 50 hr service
tasks: Grease all fittings with No. 2 lithium grease (and after every wash): rear roller hub (or 3WD clutches/bearing), steering fork shaft, steering cylinder rod end and cylinder end, 3 lift-arm pivots + 3 pivot hinges, 12 pull-frame shaft/roller points, 3 lift cylinders, traction pedal, speed-selector linkage.
Wash foam pre-cleaner in soapy water, squeeze dry (don't twist); tap paper element clean.
Check battery electrolyte; top up with distilled water to bottom of split ring (every 30 days if stored). Check cable connections; clean terminals, coat with petroleum jelly.

intervals.label: 100 hr service
tasks: Change engine oil and filter: warm engine, drain, PTFE sealant on drain plug, oil the new filter seal, hand tight +3/4-1 turn, fill to FULL on dipstick.
Service paper air element - replace if dirty/damaged (do not run without it).
Clean air-cleaner cover.

parts.name: Air cleaner cartridge (paper) - replace as needed

fluids.spec: SAE 30, API SJ or higher (Toro Premium SAE 30 108-1197)

intervals.label: 200 hr service
tasks: Torque wheel nuts 95-122 N.m.

intervals.label: 800 hr service
tasks: Replace both spark plugs: Champion RC14YC, gap 0.76 mm, torque 23 N.m.
Replace in-line fuel filter (between tank and carburettor; arrow away from tank). Close fuel tap first.
Change hydraulic fluid, filter and tank breather; run at idle 3-5 min, recheck level.
Check engine speed (idle and full throttle).
Check valve clearance (B&S Vanguard service data).

fluids.spec: Toro Premium All Season Hydraulic Fluid or HVI anti-wear ISO VG 46 (VI 140-160; ISO VG 68 option in consistently hot weather). Not synthetic (except Mobil EAL EnviroSyn 46H)

tasks: Burnish the brakes: firm brake application at mowing speed until hot; re-adjust so pedal travels 13-26 mm before shoes contact drums; both sides equal.

Replace moving hydraulic hoses (hose kit 117-2725 listed in catalog).

Grease reel-motor spline and lift arm whenever a cutting unit is removed.

intervals.label: Grind reels / replace bedknives (condition-based; club 100 h)
tasks: Grind when backlap won't restore the edge or land > 3 mm: 30 deg relief (28-32), land 0.8-1.2 mm. Reel service limit 114.3 mm (new 128.5 mm); max taper 0.25 mm.
New bedknife: new screws, outer 2 to 1 N.m, then centre-out 23-28 N.m with tool TOR510880 (no impact gun). Grind knife after fitting.
Bedbar bolts 27-36 N.m. Reel bearings are sealed - check, don't grease.

fluids.spec: SAE 30, API SJ or higher, high-quality detergent oil (Toro Premium SAE 30: 108-1197 pail, 108-1196 drum)
fluids.source: OM 3422-495 p.34-35 (1.4 L with filter). SM 12191SL says 1.65 L with new filter - fill to FULL on dipstick, do not overfill.

fluids.spec: Toro Premium All Season Hydraulic Fluid (108-1178 pail / 108-1177 drum) or HVI/low pour point anti-wear ISO VG 46; biodegradable option Mobil EAL EnviroSyn 46H only
fluids.source: OM 3422-495 p.42-43 (change capacity 25.7 L; factory fill ~32.2 L)

12 V flooded lead-acid (Toro 104-8162); top up with distilled water
18 x 9.50-8 2-ply. Front 55-83 kPa (8-12 psi), rear 55-103 kPa (8-15 psi)
fluids.source: OM 3422-495 p.37 (the OM misprints the front max as '2 psi'); SM 12191SL

bedknives.name: Fairway (catalog only, not in HOC chart)

reel.guidance: Tees at 4-5 mm: Tournament family (93-4263 / 115-1881). Daily contact check; adjust 1 click = 0.018 mm. Grind specs (CU OM 3397-897): relief 30 deg (28-32), land 0.8-1.2 mm, relief-grind when land > 3 mm; reel new 128.5 mm, service limit 114.3 mm, max taper 0.25 mm. Bedknife screws 23-28 N.m centre-out after outer pair at 1 N.m. DPA cutting units have sealed reel and roller bearings - no grease. Note: the club does not record which reels (8 or 11 blade) are fitted.

known_issues: Toro bulletin GR 02-10: original seat 104-4620 is obsolete; replacement for 04358 is seat 139-2680 (no install kit needed). This unit (403167275) is inside the affected range.
Hot-climate use: OM says fit the oil cooler kit for off-green use, verticutting or ambient above 29 C (OM gives 105-8339; parts catalog lists Oil Cooler Kit 130-6536 - confirm with dealer).
Leak detector false alarms after long idling or when the load drops - shut off rather than idle. Test function daily.
Brakes need annual burnishing to hold properly.
Notion workshop list (CALLUM): RHS wheel-bearing squeak and 'check cut 4 mm' still open. Rear wheel bearing cone & seal 115-9472 (x2) per catalog.
High hours (~3,600 h): watch for engine oil use, hard starting and hydrostatic creep (OM neutral adjustment procedure p.38).

m_models.model: Groundsmaster 4300-D rotary rough mower (5 x 22 in decks, 4WD)
m_models.engine: Yanmar 3TNV86CT: 3-cyl, 1.568 L, turbocharged common-rail diesel with cooled EGR, DOC + DPF (soot filter) with active regen, EPA Tier 4 Final. Alternator 12 V 55 A. (SM 16226SL p.3-1). kW rating not stated in the manuals read. NOT a Kubota.
daily_checks: Engine oil level (cold, before start). If ABOVE Full = fuel dilution from DPF regen -> change oil.
Drain water from fuel filter/water separator.
Coolant level in expansion tank; blow debris off rear screen, radiator and oil cooler (more often in dusty/dry rough).
Hydraulic fluid level; check hydraulic-filter indicator with engine running and oil warm (green = OK, red = change both filters).
Hydraulic hoses/lines for leaks, kinks, rubbing, loose fittings.
Air-cleaner restriction indicator.
Tyre pressure 83-103 kPa (12-15 psi) front and rear.
Safety interlocks: engine must not crank with traction pedal pressed or PTO on; PTO must not engage when off seat; no traction with park brake on.
Blade stopping time: blades stop in ~5 s after deck switch off; more than 7 s = braking valve needs dealer adjustment.
Brake and park-brake operation; instrument/InfoCenter operation.
Height of cut and blade condition (look for wear slot between sail and flat - replace, never straighten/weld).
Listen for unusual engine/operating noises; check for fluid leaks.
Clean machine; clean seatbelt. Grease all fittings straight after every wash.
Watch InfoCenter for DPF regen requests (parked regen icon / ADVISORY #188, recovery #190) and SPN 3719/3720 faults.
After mowing: idle at low idle 5 min before shut-down (turbo cool-down).

intervals.label: Break-in: first 1 h
tasks: Torque front and rear wheel-lug nuts 94-122 N.m.

intervals.label: Break-in: first 10 h
tasks: Torque wheel-lug nuts 94-122 N.m.
Check alternator-belt tension: 10 mm deflection with 44 N (10 lb) push midway.

intervals.label: First 50 h service
tasks: Change engine oil and oil filter (warm engine 5 min first).
Check fan/alternator V-belt (Yanmar 1st-time check).

fluids.spec: Low-ash API CJ-4 or higher / ACEA E6 / JASO DH-2; SAE 15W-40 preferred (10W-30 or 5W-30 alt.)

intervals.source: Toro OM 3453-435 Rev A (30864, s/n 412437987 & up) pp.48, 54-55; Yanmar TNV Common Rail Operation Manual 0ATN4-G00100 (covers 3TNV86CT) p.59

intervals.label: 50 h service
tasks: Grease bearings and bushings with No. 2 lithium grease (also straight after every wash): pump driveshaft U-joints (3); cutting-unit lift-arm cylinders (2 each); lift-arm pivots (1 each); carrier-frame pivots (1 each); lift-arm pivot shaft (1 each); axle steering pivot (1); steering-cylinder ball joints (2) + rear axle (1); brake pedal (1); deck spindle-shaft bearings (2 per deck - pump until grease shows under the spindle housing); rear-roller bearings (2 per deck - line up roller groove with grease hole).
Check battery condition, clean case, check cable connections; coat posts with Grafo 112X or petroleum jelly.

fluids.spec: No. 2 lithium (Toro Premium All Purpose Grease 108-1190)

intervals.label: 100 h service
tasks: Inspect cooling-system hoses.
Check alternator-belt tension (10 mm deflection at 44 N); adjust at alternator mounting bolts.

intervals.label: 250 h service
tasks: All 50 h + 100 h items.
Change engine oil and oil filter.
Torque wheel-lug nuts 94-122 N.m.

Service the air cleaner (earlier if indicator shows red; more often in dusty rough). Do not remove the element unless needed. Check whole intake for leaks/loose clamps; cover seated, rubber dust valve pointing down (5-7 o'clock).
Yanmar engine items at 250 h: clean radiator fins; check/adjust fan V-belt.

fluids.spec: Low-ash API CJ-4+/ACEA E6/JASO DH-2, 15W-40 preferred

intervals.source: Toro OM 3453-435 Rev A (30864, s/n 412437987 & up) pp.48-49, 53-55; Yanmar TNV Common Rail Operation Manual 0ATN4-G00100 (covers 3TNV86CT) pp.58-59

intervals.label: 400 h service
tasks: Replace engine fuel filter (lube gasket with clean oil, hand-tight + 1/2 turn).
Replace fuel-filter/water-separator canister.
Inspect fuel lines and connections (400 h or yearly, whichever first).
Prime: key ON 15-20 s, OFF 30-40 s, ON 15-20 s; check for leaks. Do NOT crank the starter to prime.
Note: Yanmar engine manual says 500 h for these filters - Toro's 400 h is the stricter and is the one to follow.

intervals.label: 800 h service
tasks: Drain and clean the fuel tank (also before storage); clean pickup-tube screen if needed.
Check rear-wheel toe-in: front of rear wheels less than 6 mm narrower than rear, measured at axle height.
Pack the rear-wheel bearings.
ONLY if not on Toro PX Extended Life hydraulic fluid (or ever topped up with another fluid): change hydraulic fluid and both hydraulic filters now.

intervals.label: 1000 h service
tasks: Replace BOTH hydraulic filters (Toro PX fluid) - sooner if the restriction indicator is red. Run 2 min to purge air, check leaks.
Yanmar 1000 h: adjust intake/exhaust valve clearance (dealer item).
Coolant: Yanmar says drain/flush/refill every 1000 h or 1 year; Toro OM says every 2 years with extended-life coolant - see 2-year entry and confirm with dealer which applies.

parts.name: Hydraulic filter element - mow & lift circuit

intervals.source: Toro OM 3453-435 Rev A (30864, s/n 412437987 & up) pp.49, 66; SM 16226SL p.4 (filter roles); Yanmar TNV Common Rail Operation Manual 0ATN4-G00100 (covers 3TNV86CT) p.58

intervals.label: 1500 h engine emission service (dealer)

reel.guidance: Rotary: 5 decks x one 22 in blade. Standard = Combination sail 108-7395-03. Angle sail 117-0209-03 for 19-64 mm HOC (cleaner discharge, less power); High-lift 114-0434-03 for higher HOC (OM: 7-10 cm; never with mulching baffle); Atomic 114-0435-03 for leaf mulching. Inspect daily for the wear slot where sail meets flat - replace, never straighten/weld. Sharpen only the top cutting edge at the original angle, same metal off both ends to keep balance; on a flat surface the ends and cutting edge should sit slightly lower than centre/heel - if higher, blade is bent: replace. Blade bolt 115-149 N.m. Blade plane: factory 50 mm HOC with 7.9 mm rake; 12 o'clock within 0.7 mm of HOC setting, 3 and 9 o'clock 1.6-6.0 mm higher and within 1.6-6.0 mm of each other (adjust with 1.5/0.7 mm shims at the HOC brackets). Check the plane after hitting anything solid.

known_issues: DPF engine: soot warnings SPN 3719 FMI 16 (85% power) / FMI 0 (50%); ash warnings SPN 3720 FMI 16/0 = DPF service due. Parked regen 30-60 min needs >=1/4 tank; recovery regen up to 3 h needs >=1/2 tank. Don't ignore parked-regen requests. Reset regen runs automatically about every 100 h. (OM pp.33-41)
Wrong oil or fuel causes DPF plugging - CJ-4/E6/DH-2 low-ash oil and ULSD only.
Engine oil above Full on dipstick = fuel dilution from regen - change the oil regardless of hours (OM p.54, Yanmar p.58).
Set InfoCenter 'Inhibit Regen' ON when running the engine in the shed on an exhaust-extraction hose (OM p.49).
Turbo: idle 5 min at low idle before shutting down after mowing (SM 16226SL).
Blade stopping time over 7 s = deck braking valve needs dealer adjustment (OM p.28).
Fuel filter/water separator: after replacing, key ON/OFF priming cycle - never crank to prime (protects high-pressure pump).
Unit at ~392 h: 400 h fuel filter + water separator now due; next oil/filter at 500 h; first 1000 h hydraulic filters later.
m_models.notes: Telematics: no factory telematics gateway is listed in catalogue 3466-650 for this serial range. The InfoCenter records machine, engine, PTO and transport hours plus a 'service due' countdown (resettable). Toro Intelli360 (successor to myTurf) shows hours, location, operating status and maintenance due for connected machines - hours come from a Toro telematics device or wireless hour meter. Check in Intelli360 (intelli360.toro.com/asset) whether s/n 417313514 is connected; if not, hours must be entered manually. Labour hours (est_labour_h) are estimates, not OEM. No AUD Toro prices are published online; AUD figures shown are what the club paid (taskTracker stock export). OM fuel tank figure conflicts (51 L table vs 53 L text) - 51 L matches the service manual.

reel.guidance: Tines CLAMP into tine heads (tine holder bolts 40.6 N·m / 30 ft-lb); they are not screw-in. parts.name: Bedknife screw (8 per knife on 5in units)

fluids.spec: Low-ash, API CH-4 or higher. SAE 15W-40 preferred (above -17 C); 10W-30 or 5W-30 alternative. Toro 121-6395 (5 gal) / 121-6394 (55 gal)
50/50 ethylene-glycol extended-life (OAT) to ASTM D3306/D4985, SAE J1034; distilled water. Don't mix with green IAT
Toro PX Extended Life Hydraulic Fluid (133-8086/133-8087) or HVI/low pour point anti-wear ISO VG 46 (VI 140+, Eaton Vickers 694). No synthetic except Toro Premium Synthetic Biodegradable
Diesel, low or ultra-low sulfur, cetane 40+, up to B20 biodiesel; summer grade above -7 C; use within 180 days
12 V starting battery 132-8621; 48 V reel pack 4 x 12 V AGM 136-3726. Charge 12 V at 3-4 A for 4-8 h. Grafo 112X (505-47) on terminals

reel.guidance: Fairways (and approaches/surrounds) at 5 mm from 21 Oct 2026 sit below the cutting-unit HOC chart (starts at 6.4 mm) and below the Low HOC knives' range. The OEM option that covers 5 mm is the Tournament knife 147-1257 (3.8-9.5 mm). The club hasn't recorded which cutting units (03621/03623/03624, or 7in) came on the leased units - check the plates. Grease the 5 fittings per unit at 50 h and after washing. Grind: 30 deg relief to 1.3 mm land when land > 3 mm; end-to-end diameter difference < 0.25 mm. Bedknife screws 29.8 +/-1 N.m; bedbar bolts 37-45 N.m. Replace the knife at its service limit (lip height above bottom: 4.8 mm, Tournament 3.4 mm). Note: 3456-847 Rev D lists newer knife numbers (147-12xx); the cutting-unit catalog 3451-988 still shows older ones (110-4084, 120-1640, 108-9096, 110-4074) - order by the newer manual numbers and let the dealer supersede.

known_issues: First oil change at 50 h is close on all three units (18-41 h). Break-in torque and belt checks (1/8/10 h) should have been done - confirm with the dealer.
Using any non-PX hydraulic fluid (even a top-up) drops the hydraulic fluid and charge-filter interval from 1,000/2,000 h to 800 h. Keep PX on hand for top-ups.
Service the air cleaner only on the indicator (or at 400 h) - early changes let dirt in.
48 V cutting-unit fuses are separate from the 12 V fuse block (fuse block at front left of engine; OM 'Replacing a 48 V Cutting Unit Fuse').
Machinery job MCH-3 (new Toro fairway mower seat won't slide - bracket welded, closed 9 Oct): check if warranty was claimed.
m_models.notes: Telematics: both parts catalogs (3471-213, 3478-264) list Telematics Gateway 161-9001, and OM 3478-261 covers installing it; the dealer activates it (Toro's myTurf/Intelli360 platform - confirm). Engine is a Kubota D1105 with Toro numbers; Kubota dealers can supply engine-only parts but use Toro numbers for filters to match the schedule. The OM schedule is identical in 3471-210 and 3478-261. Labour hours are estimates.

m_models.engine: Battery LiFePO4 25.6 V, 19.0 Ah, 486.4 Wh (battery 164-0085). Average mowing 110 min per charge, ~90 min to full charge. 5 cutting heads x 3 pivoting razor blades (15 blades), 1033 mm cut width, HOC 20-100 mm standard discs / 15-90 mm low-height discs, electronic height adjust. 71 kg. Max slope 30% (500) per spec table.
daily_checks: Wet weather: clear mud and grass off wheels and cutting heads (stop button, tip robot onto its rear, switch off, blower/compressed air/wire brush; body with damp cloth or soapy water - never solvents).
Robot returning to station and charging; no alarms in the app/portal (turfpro.toro.com).
Walk the area: molehills, stones, sprinklers, nylon markers or tall weeds near the boundary wire that will blunt blades.
Weekly (OM): inspect blades, blade screws and cutting-disc assembly; clean cutting discs (critical if HOC is 25 mm or lower).

intervals.label: 40 h clean & inspect
tasks: Charge contacts: rub with 280-grit sandpaper until clean.
Bumper: check for cuts/tears (dealer if damaged); wipe with damp cloth - no water.
Sonar sensors (5): remove mud/grass, wipe with damp cloth - no water.
Front wheels: clean; must spin freely without excess play - replace if loose.
Front wheel axle: clean and inspect.
Cutting heads: clean (compressed air best); each head must move freely back and forth (pantograph).
Cutting discs: clean; must spin smoothly. After any work, turn each head by hand - turning one must not turn the others.
Inspect cutting unit: blades, screws, disc assembly.
Rear wheels: wire-brush mud and grass off.
intervals.source: Toro Turf Pro Series Robotic Mower OM 3472-242 Rev B (30921ANZ s/n 325000000+) pp.5-2 to 5-8

intervals.label: Anti-friction disc (low HOC)

Check the wiring under the robot - dealer if any damage.

intervals.label: Yearly / before storage
tasks: Annual service by an authorised Toro technician (OM recommends at least once a year).
Battery service: let the robot manage its own cycles; if work cycles look short (check in portal), dealer checks the battery.
Storage: fully charge, switch off, clean, store dry and frost-free; cover the charging station (can stay on).
Back into service: switch on, power to station, check battery voltage on screen, start and confirm it returns to the station.
Through the season: check all screws, nuts and bolts are tight.

fluids.source: Toro Turf Pro Series Robotic Mower OM 3472-242 Rev B (30921ANZ s/n 325000000+) p.3-11

reel.guidance: Pivoting razor blades on 5 floating cutting discs. Change all 15 every 6 months (OEM) or sooner. Blade life killers per OM: uneven ground/molehills, bare patches (speed changes loosen screws), nylon markers, sprinklers/stones/roots, tall tough weeds along the boundary wire. Low HOC (25 mm or less) wears the anti-friction disc fast - check every 2 months. Set cut height per parcel in the menu; a negative value means parameters reset and blade height must be re-calibrated (calibration stops 163-3873).

known_issues: Furrows can form at the charging-station approach - level the ground or lay synthetic turf there (OM).
Removable objects (range targets, flags) are not detected - remove before scheduled mowing.
Remote wake-up/commands and schedules come through the portal/app; the robot needs 4G/RTK base comms (RTK base 30912ANZ).
m_models.notes: Telematics: NOT Intelli360 in the manuals read - the robot reports to the Toro Turf Pro web portal (turfpro.toro.com) and the Connect smartphone app (status, alarms, schedules, maps, battery cycles) via the 4G RTK base. No hour counter is described in the OM, so the 40 h jobs need run-hours from the portal or a calendar stand-in. Best-practice estimate only: at ~110 min mowing per ~90 min charge the robot can log roughly 10-13 mowing hours a day, so 40 h is about every 3-4 days at full use - a fixed twice-weekly clean is a sensible substitute. Shared site kit with the Range Pro: RTK base 30912ANZ, charging station, boundary (peripheral) wire 163-3926/163-3927 spools, surge protector kit 163-3925.

daily_checks: Seat belt(s): wear, cuts, buckle works.
Tyre pressure 165-207 kPa (24-30 psi) front and rear (lower end for light loads/turf, higher for heavy loads).
Brake-fluid level above MIN line (DOT 3) - reservoir under hood.
Brake and park-brake operation (lever should come up tight within 11.4-16.5 cm of the 'P' mark).
Direction selector and accelerator operation; instruments/display (fault codes, battery level).
Listen for unusual noises; look for fluid leaks (transaxle).
Battery charge level - plug in at end of day (charge only at 0-45 C).
Wipe charger cord/case with a damp cloth after use; coil cord; check cord for cuts.

intervals.label: Break-in (first 100 h)

Avoid hard braking for the first several hours (pads bedding in).
Check front suspension positioning / wheel alignment.
Charge batteries to 100% on delivery.

Torque wheel-lug nuts 108-122 N.m.
Steering and suspension: more than 13 mm free play at the wheel rim before the tyres move = check steering shaft/rack joint, pinion seal, tie rods, ball joints.
Check front camber and toe-in (100 h or yearly); front tyres at 138 kPa (20 psi) and operator weight on seat when checking.
Check transaxle fluid level (level with bottom of fill plug; plug 20-27 N.m) and look for leaks.
Inspect brakes: pads under 1.6 mm = replace; check rotors, lines, fittings, clamps, fluid level.
intervals.source: Toro OM 3471-379 Rev A (07433TC s/n 418000000+) and OM 3478-783 Rev B (s/n 419000000+) - identical schedules pp.32, 42-47

intervals.label: 300 h service

intervals.source: Toro OM 3471-379 Rev A (07433TC s/n 418000000+) and OM 3478-783 Rev B (s/n 419000000+) - identical schedules pp.32, 37-39

intervals.label: 400 h service
tasks: Replace service and parking-brake pads (OM: dealer to inspect and possibly replace).
Re-check parking-brake adjustment after pad work.

parts.name: Rear brake pad kit (4 pads, service + park)

intervals.source: Toro OM 3471-379 Rev A (07433TC s/n 418000000+) and OM 3478-783 Rev B (s/n 419000000+) - identical schedules pp.32, 47; Toro Parts Catalog 3471-384 Rev B (s/n 418xxxxxx) / 3478-787 Rev B (s/n 419000000+) Brake Assembly

tasks: Change transaxle fluid (800 h or yearly, whichever first): drain via transaxle cover, cover bolts 22-32 N.m, fill until it runs out of the fill hole, fill plug 20-27 N.m.
intervals.source: Toro OM 3471-379 Rev A (07433TC s/n 418000000+) and OM 3478-783 Rev B (s/n 419000000+) - identical schedules pp.32, 45

Check charger cord and plug; keep dielectric grease on charger terminals (don't wipe it off).

Storage limits: -20 to 25 C up to 52 weeks; 25-45 C max 3 weeks; 45-55 C max 1 week. Keep out of sun/rain.
Inspect brakes; clean machine (no pressure washer); batteries can stay in the vehicle.

known_issues: Club history: WO 1495 (9 Oct 2026) GTX 2 handbrake not engaging. OM fix: rear up on stands, at each rear caliper hold the adjusting post, loosen jam nut 1/4 turn, wind post in until drag, back off 1/4 turn, lock jam nut; repeat other side. If it won't adjust to tension, pads are worn (400 h item).
Special conditions (towing, dusty, cold below 10 C, construction work): OM says do maintenance twice as often.
Do not use brackish or reclaimed water to wash it.
Charger won't run outside 0-45 C; hot/cold battery icons show on display. Below 0 C performance is reduced until battery warms.
m_models.notes: Telematics: GTX 1 & 2 (s/n 418xxxxxx) have a factory Telematics Gateway 161-9001 in catalogue 3471-384 (dash/accelerator assembly, 5 A 'telematics power' fuse). Catalogue 3478-787 for s/n 419000000+ (GTX 3 & 4) no longer lists the gateway, but the 419+ OM still shows the 5 A telematics fuse - check in Intelli360 whether GTX 3 & 4 report. OM: telematics device must be activated by the Toro distributor. Intelli360 shows operating hours, location, operating status and maintenance due (PRO/ULTRA subscription for telematics activations); hour meter on the dash is the machine-hours source. Electric drive - no engine oil, coolant, air or fuel filters, spark plugs or drive belts. Labour hours are estimates.

m_models.engine: Briggs & Stratton 2-cylinder air-cooled petrol (Toro engine PN 140-2599; Toro spec page: Vanguard, 480 cc). Exact B&S model/type code is on the engine - not in the manuals read. Power rating not stated in the documents read. CVT drive (primary clutch 138-0094, secondary 136-6289, drive belt 136-6296); belt-driven starter-generator 131-8444 (pedal/key start). daily_checks: Seat belt(s) condition and buckle.
Tyre pressure 55-103 kPa (8-22 psi) front and rear, to suit load.
Engine oil level (bed up, dipstick loop pointing down when refitted).
Brake-fluid level (DOT 3) before first start.
Gear-shift operation and neutral.
Fuel level; transaxle fluid level (per daily checklist).
Air filter (inspect) and engine cooling fins clear of grass.
Brake and park-brake operation; accelerator; instruments (oil-pressure light).
Listen for unusual engine/operating noises; check for leaks.
Wash (no brackish/reclaimed water).

intervals.label: First 8 h
tasks: Check drive-belt condition.
Check starter-generator belt tension: 6 mm deflection with 44 N (10 lb) push; pivot nut 88-115 N.m.

intervals.label: First 25 h
tasks: Change engine oil and oil filter (oil filter: oil on gasket, hand tight + 1/2 to 3/4 turn; drain plug 17.6 N.m).

fluids.spec: Detergent API SL or higher. OM chart: SAE 30 above 4 C (normal Cranbourne use) or synthetic 5W-30/5W-20 all temps; 5W-30/10W-30 only -18 to 4 C

intervals.label: First 50 h
tasks: Adjust engine valve clearance (no procedure/spec in the Toro OM - use the Briggs & Stratton engine manual or dealer).

intervals.label: Break-in (first 100 h)
tasks: Follow 'breaking in a new machine' (brakes burnished, etc.).

intervals.label: 100 h service
tasks: Replace air-filter element (sooner if dirty/damaged; every few hours in very dusty/sandy work).
Change engine oil and oil filter.
Check spark plugs (100 h or yearly) - Champion RN14YC, gap 0.76 mm, 20 N.m; replace if fouled/cracked (don't sand-blast or wire-brush).
Check the carbon-canister air-filter opening is clear.
Tyres and rims; torque lug nuts 108-122 N.m.
Steering and suspension for loose/damaged parts; front camber and toe-in (100 h or yearly).
Transaxle fluid level; check neutral (0.76-1.52 mm gap at neutral bracket locknuts).
Clean engine cooling areas (twice as often in dusty conditions).
Inspect brakes: lining under 1.6 mm = replace; check fluid level.

fluids.spec: API SL+, SAE 30 (above 4 C) or synthetic 5W-30

intervals.label: 200 h service
tasks: Replace carbon-canister filter.
Adjust parking-brake handle if needed.
Check drive-belt condition and tension; check starter-generator belt tension (6 mm at 44 N).
Inspect service and parking brakes.

intervals.label: 300 h service
tasks: Clean and repack front wheel bearings with Mobilgrease XHP-222; bearing nut 15 N.m while rotating then per OM; caliper bolts 47-54 N.m; lug nuts 108-122 N.m.

intervals.label: 400 h service
tasks: Inspect fuel lines, fittings and clamps (400 h or yearly).
Clean the primary drive clutch with compressed air - goggles and dust mask (400 h or yearly).
Visually inspect rear drum brakes for worn shoes.

intervals.label: 600 h service
tasks: Adjust engine valve clearance (B&S manual / dealer).

intervals.label: 800 h service
tasks: Replace in-line fuel filter (800 h or yearly; arrow toward carburettor; disconnect battery first).
Change transaxle fluid (800 h or yearly).

intervals.label: 1000 h brake fluid
tasks: Change brake fluid (DOT 3).

fluids.spec: Detergent oil API SL or higher. OM chart (Fig 31): SAE 30 from 4 C up; 5W-30/10W-30 only -18 to 4 C; synthetic 5W-20/5W-30 -30 to 38 C+. For Cranbourne: SAE 30 or synthetic 5W-30.
Fresh unleaded, 87 (R+M)/2 or higher (91 RON in AU), up to 10% ethanol; no E15/E20/E85 or methanol

Special conditions (towing, dusty, cold below 10 C, construction work): OM says double the maintenance frequency.
Primary clutch dust is hazardous - goggles and dust mask when cleaning.
Top speed is set by primary-clutch spacers (2 standard = 16 mph); never run with fewer than 2 spacers.

m_models.model: Trailers: Dean 3 t hydraulic tipping trailers, Roshar 2.8 t trailer, Toro TransPro 80 greens-mower trailers
m_models.engine: None. Dean tippers: hydraulic tipping (power-pack/battery or tow-vehicle hydraulics - check each unit).
daily_checks: Before each tow: coupling locked and pinned; safety chain(s) connected with rated shackles; jockey wheel/stand up.
Lights and indicators working (road trailers); number plate fitted if registered.
Tyres: pressure, cuts, tread; wheel nuts tight.
Brakes (3 t / 2.8 t units): controller/breakaway connected and breakaway battery charged.
Tippers: bed down and latched, tipping-ram hose undamaged, no oil leaks; never work under a raised bed without the safety prop.
Load secured and within trailer ATM/tow-vehicle rating (TransPro: mower strapped down; ramps stowed and latched).

intervals.label: 3-monthly
tasks: Re-torque wheel nuts; check tyre condition and spare.
Check brake adjustment and operation; test breakaway system (3 t / 2.8 t).
Tippers: check hydraulic oil level in power pack, hoses/fittings, ram seals, pump battery charge and terminals; grease tipping pivots and ram pins.
Grease coupling, jockey wheel, ramp hinges (TransPro) and any pivots.
Check lights/wiring plug.
intervals.source: Best practice - no OEM manuals obtained

intervals.label: Annual
tasks: Wheel bearings: check play/noise; repack or replace and fit new seals (annually or per maker's km interval).
Brakes: inspect shoes/pads, drums/discs, magnets or hydraulic actuator; adjust.
Chassis, drawbar, coupling and safety-chain attachment: check for cracks, corrosion and wear.
Suspension springs, shackles and bushes.
Tippers: change hydraulic oil if contaminated; inspect ram and hoses.
Registration renewal for road-registered trailers; roadworthy inspection when required.
intervals.source: Best practice - no OEM manuals obtained

reel.guidance: n/a

known_issues: Breakaway battery left flat = no emergency braking.
Tipper ram/hoses leak if bed is stored raised or hoses rub.
Wheel bearings on trailers that sit wet on course get water in them - check yearly even at low km.
m_models.notes: No OEM manuals were obtained for Dean, Roshar or the Toro TransPro 80 - everything here is best practice; get the Dean and Roshar compliance plates (ATM, tyre size/pressure, brake type) and the TransPro operator/parts manual from Toro. Victorian rules to confirm with VicRoads/VSB1 (not read in this research): trailers used on public roads must be registered; a 3 t ATM trailer needs brakes on all wheels and a breakaway system, and above 2.5 t ATM two safety chains - these thresholds are from general knowledge and must be checked before relying on them, as should the assumption that trailers used only inside the course boundary need no road registration (they still need the safety checks).

m_models.model: Trenchmaster 150 three-point PTO trencher (auger-cutter type)
m_models.engine: None - tractor PTO (max 1000 rpm, optimum 520 rpm per manual; manual says select 1000 PTO and run engine ~1200 rpm). Min tractor 30 hp. 3-point linkage. Gearbox + cutter leg with replaceable tungsten-tipped auger cutters (not a digging chain).
daily_checks: Connect 3-point and PTO; set top link so the top plate slopes down toward the tractor about 20-25 deg.
PTO shaft cut to suit at trenching depth (it closes up as the machine digs) - check overlap and guards intact.
Check machine for damage/wear; replace damaged or missing parts with genuine parts.
Check all bolts before and during work (loose bolts are not covered by warranty).
Gearbox oil level.
Cutter teeth/auger cutters sharp and all present.
Grease PTO U-joints and slip joint.
In heavy going: 2-3 shots of grease into the cutter-leg nipple (bottom of cutter leg) every hour.
After use: wash off soil, store dry and under cover.

intervals.label: Every hour in heavy going - cutter leg
tasks: Lift on 3-point; give the cutter-leg grease nipple 2-3 shots (protects cutter bearings).
intervals.source: Trenchmaster 150 manual sec 5.2 Routine Lubrication

intervals.label: Each use - driveline
tasks: Grease PTO universal joints and slip joint ('regularly' per manual; each use is the practical interval).
intervals.source: Manual sec 5.2 (no hour figure given)

intervals.label: Annual / before an irrigation project
tasks: Change gearbox oil: 90-grade EP gear oil (manual: check 'at regular intervals' and replace 'periodically' - no hours given; annual change is best practice for a low-hour machine).
Inspect auger cutters/tungsten tips, cutter leg bearings (play/noise), spoil plough and depth-control blade (2 bolts).
Check frame and 3-point mounts for cracks; re-torque all bolts.
Inspect PTO shaft, guard and cross kits.
intervals.source: Manual sec 5.1-5.2 + best practice for timing

fluids.source: Manual sec 5.2 (capacity not stated - fill to level plug)

fluids.system: Driveshaft U-joints/slip joint, cutter leg nipple

reel.guidance: Trenching: engage PTO, lowest gear, lower linkage, engine ~1200 rpm, drive forward; it cuts down to the depth set on the spoil plough. Up to 1 km/h in good ground, slower in hard ground (it rides out or stalls the tractor if too fast). Creeper or hydrostatic tractor is ideal; several passes may be needed. Best cut with top plate parallel to the ground.

known_issues: Cutter-leg bearings fail early if not greased hourly in heavy ground.
PTO shaft too long at full depth damages tractor/trencher - measure at trenching depth.
Too much forward speed stalls the tractor or lifts the machine out of the cut.
m_models.notes: No telematics. Specs: 150 mm trench width (300 mm with adaptor), 100-800 mm depth, 285 kg (manual) / 290 kg (Agriquip page), 1.8 x 1.1 x 0.93 m. Manual is the NZ distributor's edition; Australian supply is via the maker (trenchmasterdigger.com) - not confirmed.
