m_models.model: RE50 electric golf greens roller (ride-on, trailer-transport)
m_models.engine: 48 V AC electric motor 2500 W, AC induction controller (E7297), reduction gearbox (Falk Ultramite double-reduction helical per Rev E; Rexnord 203UCBN2A-8.0A1B named in Rev L), toothed-belt drive to rubber-coated flex drive roller. Batteries: lead-acid standard / lithium optional on Rev E (to serial RE50-0401); lithium option = 4 x RELiON 48 V 30 Ah in parallel (120 Ah). Charger Delta-Q IC1200 48 V (R8705).
daily_checks: Batteries fully charged before going out; charge after use (no memory - top up any time, avoid running flat).
Tyres 18-24 psi, never over 24 psi.
Steering joystick has no looseness; foot pedal depresses under normal pressure.
Drawbar catch locked to main drawbar with safety pin fitted when towing; gas strut working and eyelets tight.
All nuts, bolts and grub screws tight - especially grub screws on drive-roller end-bearing lock rings and smoothing-head pivot bearings.
Lightly grease drive-roller and smoothing-head pivot bearings; refit any missing plastic caps. Oil rod ends sparingly.
Spin each smoothing roller by hand (trailer-down position): tight, rough or loose = change bearings.
Park brake holds the machine on a push test; adjust knob clockwise if not.
Store in towing position (protects trailer strut shaft).

intervals.label: Weekly
tasks: Visual check over the whole machine for loose or worn parts.
intervals.source: Rev E manual p.20 'Maintenance Schedule' note

intervals.label: Monthly
tasks: Check smoothing-roller bearings (all 6 rollers, both heads).
Check drive-roller bearings (SBLF206 units).
Check toothed drive belt: tension = 1/4 in deflection midway between sprockets; idler square to belt; check belt for wear.
Check battery connections tight and clean; check charger leads.
intervals.source: Rev E manual p.20 schedule, p.22 belt tensioning

intervals.label: 6-monthly - Interim Service Kit
tasks: Fit Tru-Turf RE50 Interim Service Kit RS2494: 2 x bearing unit (R5077 housing + R5078 bearing) and 2 x bearing unit (E7011 housing + R5078 bearing).
intervals.source: Tru-Turf Service Kits 2026 (interim kit; timing at 6 months is a suggestion - kits are sold as 'annual' and 'interim')

intervals.label: 12-monthly - Annual Service Kit
tasks: Renew smoothing-roller bearings (rebuild kit) - all rollers.
Renew drive-roller bearings.

Fit RE50 Annual Service Kit RS2498: 2 x bearing unit R5077+R5078, 2 x bearing unit E7011+R5078, smoothing-roller rebuild kit, steering return & trailer catch spring, 2 x 1/2in UNF female rod ends, 2 x 1/2in UNF studded female rod ends.
Check drive belt; replace if worn (use only E7074 8MGT-960-36 - wrong pitch belts wreck sprockets).
Check trailer gas strut; replace if weak.
Check trailer hub bearings (L44643) and seals.
Battery health check per RELiON/Trojan instructions; charger function check.
intervals.source: Rev E manual p.20 schedule (renew bearings 12-monthly) + Service Kits 2026

intervals.label: Gearbox oil
tasks: Transmission oil: manual says refer to the gearbox maker's instructions (Rexnord/Falk). Check for leaks monthly; get oil type and change interval from Rexnord for gearbox E7039 before first change.
intervals.source: Rev L manual p.22 'Changing transmission oil'

fluids.spec: Per Rexnord/Falk instructions - not stated in Tru-Turf manual
4 x RELiON 48 V 30 Ah, connected in parallel = 120 Ah; key-off draw 0.022 A, key-on 0.125 A
fluids.source: Rev E manual p.54 'Options: Lithium Batteries'

reel.guidance: Not a mower. Roll from the fringe; keep smoothing heads parallel (adjust connecting rods if disturbed). Lubricate smoothing-roller shaft bolts with anti-seize on reassembly and make sure rollers spin freely when tight.

known_issues: Smoothing-roller bearings are the main wear item - one roller already has failed front steering-roller bearings (MCH-4).
Wrong-pitch toothed belts look alike - fitting the wrong one wears sprockets fast and can fail the drive.
Key-off current draw is 0.022 A (battery gauge/hour meter) - over a long lay-up this slowly drains the pack; isolate or keep on charge per battery maker.
Controller fault codes (e.g. code 23 under-voltage cutback = batteries need charging) are listed in the manual's fault-code table.
Very high hours for a roller (~2,100-2,300 h): budget for battery capacity loss and belt/sprocket replacement.
m_models.notes: No telematics. Use Rev E manual (to serial RE50-0401) for the 2022 units; confirm serials on the plate. RB70 PETROL ROLLER (disabled): Honda GX200 6.5 hp (0.6 L SAE 10W-30; Honda schedule: oil first month/20 h then 6-monthly/100 h; plug BPR6ES gap 0.7-0.8 mm). Eaton 11 hydrostatic: 6 L incl. filter, Penrite synthetic 5W-60 (Tru-Turf R5226); change oil first 50 h then every 500 h or annually; filter every 500 h or annually; level 25-40 mm below tank top. Renew drive chain (08B-2 duplex) and roller bearings annually. Kits: RB70 interim RS2495 AUD $359.11, annual RS2499 AUD $1,224.83 (Service Kits 2026).

m_models.model: WideSpin 1550 broadcast topdresser, tow-behind
m_models.engine: Engine-powered models: Briggs & Stratton Vanguard 14 hp 400 cc (Vanguard 400, 408 cc) driving an on-board hydraulic system. Ranfurlie unit has an hour meter (~108 h) and an engine cover, so it is taken to be engine-powered (85831/85836) - confirm product number on the ID plate.
daily_checks: Before and after use: guards on the 1550 and spinner assembly present and undamaged - do not run without them.
Loose fasteners/damaged parts - tighten or fix before use. All controls work; display box OFF and power lead unplugged after use.
Tyres 138 kPa (20 psi).
Spinner wheels: alignment, damage, wear, missing hardware; spinner vanes tight.

Clean topdressing build-up off spinner, under spinner wheels, rear deflector, hopper and conveyor belt (build-up causes vibration and poor spread). Low-pressure wash only - no high-pressure wash; keep water off the display box.
Conveyor belt tension and tracking - check often during work.
Hydraulic reservoir level; look for leaks (never use hands to find leaks).
Nothing left in the hopper (tools, rocks).
Engine (engine-powered model): oil level, air cleaner, fuel. Engine cover latch secure (has broken before).

intervals.label: Periodic - spinner swivel points
tasks: Clean, inspect and lightly coat the spinner tilting/swivel points with machine oil (rust/moisture protection). Bearings on the 1550 are sealed - no greasing needed.
intervals.source: Op manual 669320 p.37 Lubrication (no interval given - monthly in season is a suggestion)

intervals.label: Engine oil (Vanguard 400) - change
tasks: Change engine oil (0.94 L). Interval here is a conservative placeholder - confirm against the Vanguard operator's manual for the engine model-type-code on the shroud and adjust.

fluids.spec: Per Vanguard manual (typically SAE 30 / 10W-30 small-engine oil) - confirm

intervals.source: Capacity: Vanguard oil FAQ (25V3/25E3 = 0.94 L). Interval: best practice - Vanguard manual not obtained

intervals.label: Annual
tasks: Service and grease the wheel bearings (more often if dusty); inspect wheel seals.
Full clean of hopper, both sides of belt, spinner (low pressure).
Inspect conveyor belt, splice, scraper, pan and plastic pan cover; idler and drive rollers and their 4 pillow-block bearings (665429).
Inspect spinner vanes (669024 LH / 669025 RH) and spinner motor seals.
Check hydraulic hoses/fittings and hydraulic oil condition (spec per engine-powered model manual - not obtained).
Engine: air cleaner (Vanguard cyclonic cartridge rated to 600 h), spark plug, fuel system per Vanguard manual.
Check engine cover latch and hinge.
intervals.source: Op manual 669320 p.37-41 (wheel bearings once a year) + Vanguard page (air cleaner 600 h)

intervals.label: Storage (long-term)
tasks: Full inspection and clean; full lubrication; film of light oil on spinner wheels.
Release conveyor-belt tension; store out of direct sun.
On return: re-tension belt (initial setting 19 mm / 3/4 in at adjuster-screw ends), reconnect battery, lubricate.
intervals.source: Op manual 669320 p.35 Storage, p.39

fluids.spec: Not obtained - engine-powered model manual not publicly available

reel.guidance: Not a mower. Belt tension: start at 19 mm (3/4 in) at the adjuster-screw ends; if it slips under load tighten both screws equally 1/4 turn at a time. Tracking: fix unequal tension first, small adjustments, both ends of the rear roller should be visible.

known_issues: Engine cover latch has broken before on this unit - check each use.
Topdressing build-up on spinners/deflectors causes vibration and poor spread.
Belt slips under load if tension low; mistracks if adjusters uneven; belt must not rub hopper seals or frame.
High-pressure washing damages the display box and belt - low pressure only.
m_models.notes: No telematics. The only public operator manual found is for the hydraulic (no-engine) tow-behind 85824/85825. Engine-powered 85831/85836 adds the Vanguard engine and its own hydraulic pump/reservoir - get that manual (and hydraulic oil/filter spec) from Turfco or the dealer. Turfco dealer in AU not confirmed in this research.

m_models.model: ZTX zero-turn mower (23 hp, fabricated deck) - ZTX2342F (42 in) or ZTX2348F (48 in)
m_models.engine: Briggs & Stratton Professional Series OHV 23 hp gross (exact engine model-type-code not published - read engine label). Dual Hydro-Gear EZT transaxles. 11.4 L fuel tank.
daily_checks: Engine oil level; fuel; air cleaner/pre-cleaner condition.
Blades: sharp, not bent, bolts tight; deck underside clear of build-up.
Tyre pressures even (uneven = uneven cut and pull).
Safety interlocks: seat switch, park brake, blade engage.
Clean grass off engine screen/cooling fins and around transaxles (EZT units are air-cooled).

intervals.label: Every 25 h
tasks: Inspect/sharpen blades (sooner if hitting debris).
Grease deck spindles (cast-aluminium greasable spindles) and front caster pivots.
Clean air-cleaner pre-cleaner.
intervals.source: Best practice - Victa/B&S operator manual not obtained

intervals.label: Engine oil and filter
tasks: Change engine oil and filter (first change early - break-in). Confirm interval, oil spec, capacity and filter number in the B&S operator manual for the engine model-type-code.
intervals.source: Best practice placeholder - B&S manual not obtained

intervals.label: Annual
tasks: Replace air filter and spark plugs.
Replace fuel filter (if fitted).
Check deck belt and pulleys/idlers; check deck level.
Check EZT transaxles for leaks and cooling-fan/fin condition (EZT are sealed units).
Battery terminals; tyres; seat/ROPS hardware.
intervals.source: Best practice

reel.guidance: Rotary deck, 7-13 HOC positions 38-114 mm depending on model. Sharpen to original angle, balance blades after sharpening, replace if bent/cracked or worn into the sail.

known_issues: Domestic-rated product (3-year domestic warranty) being used commercially - expect shorter component life.
Grass build-up on EZT transaxle fins causes overheating and loss of drive.
m_models.notes: Victa's own site blocked automated access, so no Victa/B&S operator manual was read - intervals are best practice. Serial 1808210691573 looks like a B&S-style date-coded serial (possibly built 21 Aug 2018) - unverified. Confirm deck size (42 vs 48 in) and engine code on site.

m_models.model: Terra Rake 230 Natural Turf (3-point verticut harrow, spring tines)
m_models.engine: None - tractor 3-point (Cat 0/Cat 1 top-link heights), no PTO. Min tractor 18 kW (25 hp). Works at 10-15 km/h.
daily_checks: Spring tines all present, none broken (5-year breakage warranty - keep broken tines for claims).
Tine hexagon nuts tight; clamping sleeves on axle ends in place.
Depth (sensing) wheels turn freely; adjustment pins/clips present.
3-point pins and linch pins in.
After use: clean tines (water OK but dry to prevent rust; avoid compressed air into bearings); check for loose parts and corrosion.

intervals.label: Periodic - lubrication
tasks: Grease the support (sensing) wheel bearing nipples - clean nipple first, wipe off excess.
Keep exposed parts, threaded spindles and guides lightly lubricated.
intervals.source: Operating instructions 8.2-8.3 (no interval stated; monthly in use is a suggestion)

intervals.label: Before season / after long standstill
tasks: Lubricate and service the entire machine before first use after storage.
Replace broken spring elements: loosen hex nuts on the faulty elements, remove clamping sleeves both ends, pull axle out, swap elements, refit axle and sleeves, tighten nuts.
Re-torque fasteners to the metric torque table (e.g. M12 8.8 dry 95 Nm, M16 8.8 dry 240 Nm).
Touch up paint on frame damage.
intervals.source: Operating instructions 8.2, 8.5, 10.2

reel.guidance: Working depth/aggression set by the depth adjustment (sensing wheels). Drive 10-15 km/h for full tine vibration; never reverse with tines in the turf.

known_issues: Tines snap on rocks/roots - claim under the 5-year breakage warranty.
Compressed-air cleaning blows dirt into bearings - avoid.
m_models.notes: Specs: working width 2,260 mm, machine width 2,300 mm, 188 kg (191 kg with strain-relief kit), 16 mm row spacing, 4 tine rows. No telematics.

m_updates.job: Hydraulic steering needs checking
m_updates.note:
Checked steering, steering fine.
Combination of things that can make it feel stiff:

Road tyre opposed to the off road style - a larger contact patch on the ground, more friction to overcome 

Testing it on the concrete floor - more friction than on dirt or sand

Low engine revs - steering pump runs off hydraulic pump which is controlled by engine revs, more engine revs more oil pressure to actuate steering cylinder.

Testing whilst moving - less friction created by tyre since there's less differential of distance travelled.
